ns2:section.sectionText: "Deutsch im Berufsalltag" [German in the World of Work] will be the focus of the course. The textbook follows a young American who is seeking an internship, later is working in Berlin. Topics stretch from want ads, via office organization, advertising, marketing, banking and the stock market to leadership hierarchies in corporations. Annotations in English next to the texts help with new terms. There is also a German-English glossary at the back of the text. Text: Michael Hager, Deutsch im Berufsalltag (Forth Worth, TX: Harcourt College Published, 2002).
